body.summary: Sub-case B fix: added _export_name_from_symbol helper and sub-case B detection in synthetic_changes_for_scan. When a call site uses an export absent from the installed version (e.g. sentry.startTransaction, removed in v8, lockfile=v10), sub-case A (installed-latest diff) misses it. Sub-case B now fetches installed exports directly and creates a synthetic BreakingChange(old_version=0.0.0, new_version=installed, confidence=0.9). Added 8 new tests. 917 tests pass, lint clean, typecheck clean.
